title: Welcomes Mole and Rat
description: Badger welcomes Mole and Rat into his house, provides them with warm clothing and food, and listens to their concerns about Toad.

title: Intervenes in Toad's Motor-Car Addiction
description: Badger arrives at Toad Hall to confront Toad about his motor-car addiction, instructs the chauffeur not to wait for Toad, and takes a reluctant Toad inside to talk.

title: Lectures Toad
description: Badger lectures Toad in the smoking room, leading Toad to briefly promise to give up cars but later admits he is not truly sorry.

title: Discusses Toad's Fate
description: Rat informs Toad about the debate over his fate, with Mole and Badger remaining loyal to him.

title: Reclaims Toad Hall
description: Badger directs the animals in overpowering the Weasels and restoring order in Toad Hall.
